page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor. Operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, this configuration provides 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. Storage is a key feature of this instance, which includes a bundled 3839 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a 6 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the Passmark CPU score and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth remains average for both cached and uncached read and write operations, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the substantial 3839 GB local SSD storage and average multi-core capabilities, this instance is well-suited for database operations, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing workloads. It achieves average throughput in Redis SET operations and static web serving. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of a large local SSD storage volume provides high resource density for storage-heavy applications, offsetting the lower single-core CPU performance.
